title: Colored Foliage
description: A Mod That lets you Dye Nearly all of the plants in Vanilla Minecraft.
body: # **Colored Foliage** This Mods Adds New Variants to the Flowers And Plant that we all Know and Love. The Way you Optain Them is just by dyeing the flower/Plant with any Dye. The Purpose of them is just to fit Right into your build that your are Building. ### Some Flowers of the Mod ![Some Flowers of the Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/609c5b650a7b32a8f5ba5d291cdd4c0f5d26ad0a.png) ## Plans for full Release - Finishing all Flowers - beginning the Plants like Grass - Making a Secret Flower # Credits - Main Coder and Artist: **Izora_09** - Creator of the Mod Icon: **Orion_v1** - This mod has been Created for the Suncat SMP Thank you **ttomcat** for Running the Server.
